containerHelp: Slots can be Docker containers or virtual machines with independent hardware identities.
clusterHelp: Connect more VPS hosts over SSH, place slots on nodes and use nearby egress.
logsHelp: Logs show which slot handled each request and how many tokens it used.
multiUserHelp: Administrators manage resources and billing, operators maintain capacity, and users access authorized groups and manage their own keys and spending.
protocolHelp: Clients call standard endpoints as usual. The model service sanitizes requests and passes them to official processes inside slots.
isolationHelp: Each account gets a slot with its own session, fingerprint and egress. None are shared.
preflightHelp: Every request is sanitized and audited for risk before a slot is selected.
quotaSchedulingHelp: Select slots using official 5h / 7d usage windows. Slots step aside near thresholds, while sessions stay on the same slot whenever possible.
quotaIllustration: Illustration only. See actual usage windows on the console's Virtual machines page.
showGuideAgain: The guide will be shown again
checklistTitle: Get this model service ready in minutes
checklistHelp: Status comes from the model service's live data. Refresh after completing a step to see it checked off.
guideFooter: Skipping or finishing marks the guide as used and stops automatic prompts. You can reopen it from Welcome and setup in the user menu.
keySecurity: Use an sk-vm-… key issued by the console. It can be viewed or rotated. Never share it publicly.
masterSecurity: The master's TAPMODELS_API_KEY can modify the console. Do not put it in clients.
baseUrlHelp: Use the host as the base URL for Claude Code; append /v1 for Codex and the OpenAI SDK.
firstRequestTitle: View your first request in the console
consoleHelp: The console shows each slot's quota, every scheduling decision and every request log.
heroDescription: Official clients run in isolated slots, each with its own account and egress. Anthropic / OpenAI-compatible APIs let Claude Code, Codex and existing SDKs connect by changing a URL.
noPlugins: Connect by changing the base URL and key. No plugins or patches needed.
overviewHelp: Cluster health, account availability and request quality over the last hour.
statisticsHelp: Requests, spend, latency, and rankings by user, provider and model.
logPageHelp: Individual requests with filtering, export and detail views.
operationsHelp: Runtime health, request quality, queues, tasks and alerts.
groupsHelp: Available services, models and billing methods. Administrators and operators maintain resource associations here.
vmUsageHelp: Slot list. Each row shows usage windows, 5h / 7d remaining quota and reset times, with no separate usage page.
vmControlsHelp: Scheduling switches, concurrency and limits are also on slots. Accounts not checked yet are marked unchecked.
importHelp: Create slots, bind egress and add subscription credentials.
specsHelp: Machine specifications and host KVM settings for new slots.
proxiesHelp: Egress for each slot, including local px-local.
modelsHelp: Public model catalog, parameters, aliases and official pricing.
auditHelp: Inbound requests pass through distillation, strict regex checks, refusal caching and the decision model. Blocked requests never leave the model service.
auditModeHelp: Personal mode disables all four checks. Relay mode keeps distillation, strict regex checks and refusal caching on, with the decision model off by default.
promptsHelp: System prompts substituted for outbound requests from unofficial clients. Defaults to the full official prompt.
keyFundingHelp: Do not put the master key in environment variables. Select services through groups; all keys share account funds and limits.
directApiHelp: Call Anthropic Messages directly without a virtual machine.
directApiConfigHelp: Defaults to the official URL and x-api-key. URL, authentication and proxy are configurable; requests can also be routed through configured API endpoints.
billingHelp: Account balances, pending reservations and transactions.
subscriptionsHelp: Group subscriptions, expiry dates and remaining rolling-window quotas.
usersHelp: Administrators manage users, group access, concurrency limits and credits.
settingsHelp: Global settings for stickiness, account pools, quotas, probes and notifications. The Quotas tab contains 5h/7d thresholds and concurrency.
quotaModeHelp: Personal mode disables quota gates and maximizes thresholds and concurrency. Relay mode uses factory thresholds.
kernelHelp: The data plane for the CLI and Rust kernel inside slots.
reinstallHelp: Reinstallation deploys the current data-plane kernel and restarts it without changing credentials or proxies or deleting containers. Fetch a GitHub Release first, then reinstall with one click.
databaseHelp: SQLite size and log storage usage.
installHelp: Start the control plane with the install script or Docker Compose, then open /console to sign in.
quickImportHelp: Create a slot, bind egress and add a subscription account. Enable scheduling after official bootstrap finishes.
callHelp: Issue an sk-vm- key and point the client's base URL to this model service.
quickStartHelp: Follow the production path: set up the control plane, then schedulable slots, and finally clients.
quotaAligned: Scheduling aligned with official quota windows
stepServicesHelp: Check authorized groups, models and your balance or subscription before creating a key.
stepPasswordHelp: Do not keep 123456 from the environment variables in production. Change the administrator password on the Users page.
stepEgressHelp: Each slot needs its own egress before going online. Local px-local also counts.
stepAccountHelp: Create a slot and add subscription credentials so the official client can run.
stepScheduleHelp: Enable scheduling on a slot with credentials so the model service can send requests to it.
stepKeyHelp: Give the client an sk-vm- key. Do not put the master key in environment variables.
stepRequestHelp: After connecting to /v1, a 2xx response in the logs marks initial setup as complete.
personalHelp: Disable the 5-hour and 7-day gates. Set all three threshold tiers to 100% and execution concurrency to 256; requests per minute remain unlimited. Disable distillation, strict regex checks and refusal caching. Keep the decision model off and set its threshold to 0.
relayHelp: Keep the 5-hour and 7-day gates enabled. Concurrency is 2 for default / Pro and 4 for Max. Thresholds are 85% / 80%, or 95% for Max. Distillation, strict regex checks and refusal caching are on; the decision model is off.
usageTitle: Choose how to use this model service
usageHelp: Only VM limits and risk controls change. Prompts, probes and health caching keep their current defaults; other settings stay unchanged.
capabilitiesTitle: Official clients run in slots.<break/>The model service handles scheduling and isolation.
clientsTitle: Change one URL.<break/>Keep using your existing tools.
claudeBaseHint: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is the host URL, without /v1
codexKeyHint: env_key refers to TAPMODELS_KEY, not the master's TAPMODELS_API_KEY
curlHint: Returns content when authorized and a schedulable slot is available
guideCompletedNotice: The guide is completed and will no longer open automatically.
guideDismissedNotice: The guide was skipped and will no longer open automatically.
saveModeFailed: {{message}} This change was not saved. The previous selection still applies.
marketingAgentsDescription: Connect Claude Code and other coding agents with a Base URL and API key, then monitor every request and its cost in the console.
marketingAgentsTitle: Connect the leading coding agents directly
marketingCompatibleHelp: Use Anthropic Messages (/v1/messages) and OpenAI-compatible APIs through the same model service.
marketingControlAuditHelp: Trace the model, token counts and cost for every request.
marketingControlDescription: IT and finance need clear answers: who used what, what it cost and where to set limits.
marketingControlKeysHelp: Give each person or project its own key and disable it at any time.
marketingControlQuotaHelp: Set quotas and per-minute request limits before spend gets out of control.
marketingControlTitle: An enterprise AI platform you can govern
marketingControlUsersHelp: Organize members by department or project in one place.
marketingCtaDescription: Get an API key, or explore the available models and rates first.
marketingCtaTitle: Start with your next API request
marketingFeatureControlHelp: Group users by department or project, issue individual keys and set budgets and rate limits.
marketingFeatureGatewayHelp: Use both leading API formats. Change the model name to switch models; update two settings for Agent tools.
marketingFeaturePrivacyHelp: Prompts and responses are not stored by default, and customer content is not used to train models.
marketingFeatureRoutingHelp: Sticky sessions improve cache hits; health and cost guide route selection, with automatic failover on errors.
marketingHeroDescription: AI for business, with less cost, more stability and clearer control. Use Claude, GPT and other leading models through one API, with integrations, keys and billing in one place so your team can focus on the product.
marketingHeroPointOne: Compatible with Anthropic and OpenAI formats
marketingHeroPointThree: Prompts and responses are not stored by default
marketingHeroSecondary: Talk to us about an enterprise plan
marketingHeroTitle: Leading AI models, one connected platform.
marketingHowDescription: Change the endpoint and key in your existing app. The model service handles routing, failover and billing before sending the request to the model provider.
marketingModelsDescription: Reference pricing (US$ / million tokens). Input, output and cache usage are billed separately; enterprise volume plans are quoted separately.
marketingModelsNote: Reference prices follow provider announcements; actual prices are based on your quote.
marketingSecurityDescription: Requests travel only through the path needed to produce a response. The model service does not retain prompt or response content.
marketingSecurityRetentionHelp: Prompts and responses are not stored by default; only token counts, latency and other billing data are retained.
marketingSecurityTrainingHelp: Customer content is not used to train models.
marketingSecurityTransferHelp: Content is sent to the model only to produce the AI response and is not used for other purposes.
marketingStepClientHelp: Your system, Claude Code, Codex or another Agent tool sends the request.
marketingStepGatewayHelp: Smart routing, sticky sessions, automatic failover and request-level billing happen here.
marketingStepProviderHelp: Claude, GPT and other leading models respond under the provider's enterprise API terms.
marketingWhyDescription: Multiple integrations, scattered keys and fragmented billing are the three common blockers to adopting AI in business. TapModels.ai solves them together.
marketingWhyTitle: One API for the leading AI models
marketingConsoleTitle: An enterprise dashboard for usage and spend
marketingConsoleDescription: Track key metrics, model distribution, group usage and token trends in one console.
marketingSupportedTools: OpenCode · Roo Code · Grok Build CLI · Any OpenAI / Anthropic-compatible program
marketingClaudeHelp: Set two environment variables to get started. Sticky sessions help reduce the cost of long conversations.
marketingCodexHelp: Update one configuration file to get started, with conversation continuation and WebSocket support.
